message.content:
This document is a technical README for **Project Maya**, a local inference engine for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Quantization & Quality**
- Maya quants (Maya-S/S24/M/L) are made from released weights and benchmarked against originals: GLM-5.3 retains 97.7–99.2% zero-shot accuracy and 83–90% next-token agreement; DeepSeek V4.
